paper_title: Axion phenomenology and theta-dependence from N_f = 2+1 lattice QCD
notes: Lattice QCD (N_f=2+1, physical quark masses) study of the topological susceptibility chi(T) and non-Gaussianity coefficient b_2(T), used to fix the temperature-dependent axion potential and compute the misalignment relic abundance. It is a first-principles theory/cosmology calculation, not an experimental or observational exclusion of any coupling. Figure 10 plots the axion decay constant f_a vs the initial misalignment angle theta_0 required to reproduce the observed dark matter abundance (Omega_DM = 0.259) - a relic-abundance prediction, not an exclusion curve on a coupling. No new measured limit on any of the AxionLimitBench couplings, and no experimental sensitivity projection. Hence is_new_limit=false, is_projection=false, no data points.
